messages.author: f11b52e0e4d4a168
messages.subject: How to specify monotone parameters?
parts:
In my model, there is a vector parameter that is monotone increasing. For example, P[1] < P[2] < P[3].

I know that in stan, we can put constraint when we declare parameters. But, can we use parameter as constraint value? For example,

parameters {
  real P1;
  real<lower=P1> P2;
  real<lower=P2> P3;
}


Is there other efficient way?


Thank you for the help
leeang

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to specify monotone parameters?
parts:
Hi leeang,

There's an 'ordered' type just for that. If you were to instead declare your parameters as:

  parameters {
    ordered[3] P;
  }

Then P[1] < P[2] < P[3].


You can also constrain 2 parameters as you've described.



Daniel
